title: Monochromatic Sublattices in Random and Cardinality Colourings of the Boolean Lattice

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
Let f(n) be the largest m such that every 2-colouring of the subsets of an n-element set has a monochromatic sublattice with m members (Erdős Problem 1183). In a uniformly random k-colouring the largest monochromatic sublattice has (1+o(1)) n log_k n members with high probability, so f(n) <= (1+o(1)) n log_2 n. For colourings by cardinality the optimum is found for every n <= 25, and with the lower bounds of arXiv:2610.02833 this gives f(n) for n <= 22 and n = 24, with 13 <= f(23) <= 14 and 14 <= f(25) <= 15. The order of growth of f(n) remains open.

The archive contains the paper (PDF, LaTeX source with the figures as PNG, arXiv tarball), the optimal words and SAT certificates, the C++ and Python programs that produce and check them, and a Lean 4 development with Mathlib of the product construction.
